DECISION: continue
TIER: milestone
EDITS:
WHY: The recommendation rewrites the milestone clause and would push against the standing constraint (storage.FORMAT stays 2) — a wall to pass, not remove; the milestone never says fee *state* must be persisted, only that fee_summary reports what members owe.
Late fees are a function of data storage already keeps (loan due date, return date, member kind via fee_cap), so T2's outstanding_cents/fee_summary can derive fees at read time from persisted loans rather than storing fee fields; T3 then formats those lines through format_cents with no format bump.
Only if some fee input is genuinely non-derivable from FORMAT 2 records (e.g. manual waivers or partial payments already in scope) should the expert return blocked again naming that field — that would be a developer question on FORMAT 3, not a milestone rewrite.
